row.proto: float(void *tyre_curve, float load, float slip_rad, float *stiffness_out)
row.notes: Pacejka Magic Formula over a CarTyreMfCurve: load rows [+0x10,+0x18) 32 bytes {Load, Peak, PeakMin, PeakMax, DownSlope, UpSlope, Shape} lerped by load; camber rows [+0x30,+0x38) {Camber, GripGain} interpolated at camber 0 only. a = slip_rad*180/pi; Ba = UpSlope*a; F = D*sin(DownSlope*atan(Ba - Shape*(Ba - atan(Ba)))), D = -(1+GripGain(0))*Peak. stiffness_out = slope at 0.01 deg. Callers: Car_Suspension_SolveWheels x4 per step, Car_Parse_TyreModel x9 (precompute at load), Car_PadAssist_DriftAssist x2.

verify.notes: V1291 Load rows 32 bytes from [+0x10,+0x18) lerped by load (Peak +4, DownSlope +0x10, UpSlope +0x14, Shape +0x18), camber rows 8 bytes from [+0x30,+0x38) interpolated at 0; a = slip*180/pi; F = D*sin(C*atan(Ba - E(Ba - atan Ba))), D = -(1+GripGain)*Peak; stiffness_out at 0.01 if non-null.
